title: Apparatus and view mapping across the four conditions
claim: R01–R04 change the source of the displayed view and physical/virtual manipulation; R04 separates a fixed overhead camera from the participant-controlled hands.

panels.detail: The screen follows the head; the camera remains fixed in the world. Keep display and controller arrows separate. The display is inside each headset, not an external monitor.

caption: Apparatus and view mapping in the four study conditions (schematic, not to scale). R02 uses one overhead camera phone and two participant viewing phones, with barriers blocking direct sight of the physical pieces. R03 provides local first-person views in two networked Quest 3 headsets. R04 displays the fixed overhead camera on a head-following screen inside each headset while retaining tracked controller manipulation. The VR schematic represents the shared-target collection arrangement used for G03–G06; the earlier G01 target arrangement is described in Section 3.3.
